review_note: Exactly ten selected 16:9 landscape candidates are pinned to art/plans/d097.json (SHA-256 d034006eb1e0cc41d6988e60886b96abc70327ad3e7e015abd56f36fd79b34b2). S005 selects v008: the sage’s hands and both feet are hidden under cloth, all celestial feet remain hidden, and four inspected skin-only cheek R−B values are 117/110/119/116. S007 selects v009: infant skin samples are RGB (62,78,117) B−R 55 and (60,75,116) B−R 56, reading deep muted indigo; the raised foot-to-lips pose remains and the contact toe cluster is partly occluded, so producer outcome is uncertain for that count. All selected artwork remains unapproved and awaits a fresh independent all-ten review.
